# Robin Cloutier
> Senior Software Engineer | AI Platform and Infrastructure

I build the plumbing that lets AI agents reach real systems safely, and the pipelines that get them into production. 15+ years across backend services, Kubernetes platforms, and data systems.

## Projects
- [Conclave](https://example.com/projects/conclave): Open-source Agent Peer Protocol and Reputation System for collaborative AI agents.
- [HUNTLOG](https://example.com/projects/huntlog): React-based job tracking application with custom pipeline management.
- [MCP Gateway Pattern](https://example.com/projects/mcp-gateway): Generic writeup of an MCP gateway pattern for agent access to backend systems with fine-grained control.
- [MicroK8s Home Lab](https://example.com/projects/microk8s-homelab): Self-hosted Kubernetes cluster running at home with GitOps and observability.
- [stcommand](https://example.com/projects/stcommand): Application for playing the SpaceTraders API game with a focus on automation.
